question: If (2, 2) and (5, -2) are two consecutive vertices of a square, then the length of each side of the square will be:
solution:
Given:

Formula used:

Calculation:

Distance between the two points = sqrt{(2-5)²+(2-(-2))²}=sqrt{9+16}=5 units
